definitions: Collaboration and cooperation among individuals are essential for achieving success.
Working together as a group is the most effective way to accomplish a goal or aspiration.
examples: Our project was a huge success; teamwork makes the dream work!
Remember, teamwork makes the dream work if we want to finish on time.
The coach always says teamwork makes the dream work, and it's true for our team.
synonyms: together we stand, divided we fall
